title: Enforce completion requires summary entry
problem: Tasks appear completed without summary entries, breaking PM visibility and control.
fullPrompt: Codify and enforce rule: delegated task is not complete until required summary is appended in docs/master-control.md. Update fixed instructions and packet/routing rules to mark missing summary as non-compliant completion. Add a concise backfill protocol for missing summaries and a checklist PM can run before considering a task done.
doneCriteria: Rules updated, non-compliant state defined, backfill protocol documented, PM checklist added. Summary appended.
reportBack: Append summary to docs/master-control.md with policy changes and enforcement checklist.
modelReason: Narrow and well-scoped task where fast iteration is enough.
